title: Daphniphyllum macropodum genome assembly and multiplexed screening unveils alkaloid modifying enzymes
authors: Swamidatta, S. H., Radzikowska, B. A., Taylor, D. J. et al.
abstract: Daphniphyllum macropodum, a small shrub or tree native to East Asia, produces bioactive polycyclic alkaloids of remarkable complexity and variety, making them long-standing, attractive targets for chemical synthesis. However, the biosynthetic origins of Daphniphyllum alkaloids remain unknown, and no pathway-associated enzymes have been identified to date.
